"""Generate the fixed-instance clutter_plastic trajectory with robot actions only."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_robolab import Session

OUT = Path('/app/output')

def run(s):
    p = s.primitives()
    q = p['top_down_quat'](0.0)
    def move(pos, speed=0.18):
        p['move_ee'](pos, q, speed=speed, tol=0.003, settle=3)
    s.record_start()
    p['open_gripper']()
    # Each entry is grasp xyz, transit height, destination xyz.
    plan = [
        ([0.4265, 0.1892, 0.052], 0.31, [0.410, -0.300, 0.095]),
        ([0.5617, 0.3863, 0.093], 0.34, [0.505, -0.300, 0.133]),
        ([0.6447, 0.4029, 0.128], 0.36, [0.600, -0.300, 0.168]),
    ]
    for grasp, height, destination in plan:
        move([grasp[0], grasp[1], height])
        move(grasp, speed=0.08)
        p['close_gripper'](steps=22)
        move([grasp[0], grasp[1], height], speed=0.12)
        move([destination[0], destination[1], height])
        move(destination, speed=0.10)
        p['open_gripper'](steps=20)
        if s.status()['success']:
            break
        move([destination[0], destination[1], height], speed=0.12)
        p['hold'](10)
    actions = s.record_stop()
    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / 'trajectory.npz')
    print(s.status(), flush=True)
    return actions

if __name__ == '__main__':
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    session = Session('clutter_plastic', instance='/app/instance.json')
    run(session)
